context.why: Mounting this package's URL configuration is the one step that cannot be made automatic — Django gives an installed application no way to add routes to a project's root URLs. So a project can install the backend, install this package, and forget that line. What it must see then is the Account Center working normally with nothing of this package on it. A dead link is worse than an absent one, and a card whose link cannot resolve is worse still because it raises while rendering and takes the whole page down.

spec_sections: User Story 4 - Nothing is offered that cannot be reached
prior_decisions: D3 — the guard already exists. Contribution.is_reachable() asks whether the namespace's pages reverse, and the card tag already filters on it. django-flex-menus already hides a navigation leaf whose URL will not reverse, so the navigation half needs nothing at all. This story is the test that turns both into guarantees, and is expected to add no production code.

Two earlier stories established that overriding INSTALLED_APPS or ROOT_URLCONF inside a running test does not always reach state built once at process start. tests/settings_without_backend.py and tests/settings_with_another_card.py boot a fresh process for exactly that reason. Decide which approach this story needs and say why; do not assume either.
context.conventions: CONSTITUTION.md Articles X (test structure) and XVI (assert rendered output, never the presence of a class name).

acceptance.given_when_then: Given the backend installed and this package's URL configuration NOT mounted, when a signed-in person opens the Account Center, then the page renders with status 200, no navigation entry belonging to the backend appears, no card belonging to it appears, and nothing raises. Build the state with a URL configuration module that omits this package's include, named in tasks.md. Prove the test has teeth: mount the include in that configuration and confirm the test goes red.

Given the tests above, when they run, then they pass with no production change. If they do not, the fix belongs on Contribution where both halves of availability already live, not in the tag or the template.
